operations.title: The current norm construction cannot host a nontrivial zeta spectrum
operations.statement: All canonical local determinants derived from norm homology equal 1, so their global product is 1 and has no nontrivial zeros or poles. Prime weights, invertible Frobenius eigenvalues, regularization, archimedean factors, and a global trace operator are not derived and cannot be inserted without begging the emergence question. The zeta-spectrum question is therefore ill-typed for the present object.
operations.scope: Typing obstruction for the current norm construction, not a no-go theorem for future geometric enlargements.

operations.title: Trivial-local-factor global hostile test
operations.procedure: Assemble only admitted local determinants from Ledger 1352. Each is 1, hence every finite partial product and the formal global product are 1.
operations.expected_result: No nontrivial zero or pole occurs. A source-derived nontrivial local determinant and proved completed global comparison would falsify the present obstruction.
